headline_marked: Philips Hue [[Essential kit $79.99]], 4 bulbs, Hue Bridge
headline: Philips Hue Essential kit $79.99, 4 bulbs, Hue Bridge
summary: Smart lighting bundle at an all-time low price
details: The Philips Hue Essential starter kit, which includes four white and color E26 bulbs and a Hue Bridge, is now $79.99 at Amazon. This matches the price of the two-bulb Essential starter kit, effectively making it a deal where you get two bulbs for free.

Each bulb can display millions of colors or tunable white light ranging from 2200K to 6500K and produce up to 800 lumens of brightness. The Hue app offers preset lighting scenes and allows for custom scenes, scheduling, and automation.

The included Hue Bridge enables remote control, connection to up to 50 lights, and integration with major smart home platforms via Matter compatibility. However, the bulbs only dim to 2% and may not match the color accuracy of Philips Hue's flagship bulbs.
